headline.trade_base: ~US$50m (H1 2025 basis), +44.7% YoY — small base, fast growth
headline.entry_barrier: CDSCO import registration (Form COS-1 -> COS-2 via SUGAM portal) — pre-clearance before any consignment; key friction and lead-time cost
headline.momentum: K-beauty is accelerating its India entry to offset SWANA-region volatility (Personal Care Insights, Apr 2026). 2026 launches: APR's Medicube (Nykaa + Tira), AmorePacific's Illiyoon (Nykaa exclusive), TirTir (Nykaa, Jun 2026), Tira's Hince (Jan) and Dr. Melaxin (Jul). India K-beauty ~INR 3,139cr (2025) forecast ~26% CAGR to ~INR 32,424cr by 2035 (Expert Market Research). AmorePacific is scaling India via platforms/imports, NOT local manufacturing — no India plant announced.

conduits.name: Nykaa
conduits.notes: Primary conduit; 10-year AmorePacific partnership (2016-2026), India's largest Korean portfolio (skincare/derma/haircare). Illiyoon newest exclusive (2026). Now also carries non-AmorePacific K-brands (TirTir, Medicube).

conduits.notes: Reliance Retail omnichannel beauty platform; aggressive 2026 K-beauty sprint with exclusive launches (online + select stores)

conduits.notes: Tier 2/3 access rail; masstige-price derma K-beauty via dark stores is the corridor's clearest whitespace per baseline §4.5

india_side_players.dynamic: Platform land-grab (Nykaa's 10-yr AmorePacific tie-up vs Reliance Tira's 2026 sprint) plus Indian D2C brands going Korean. The competitive line runs incumbent Korean majors (AmorePacific) vs indie K-beauty vs Indian challengers.

indian_brands.angle: Korean Rice Water range (new launch); markets Korean/global rituals, made-in-India, vegan

indian_brands.name: Limese
indian_brands.angle: K-beauty formulations manufactured IN KOREA, tuned for Indian skin (snail mucin, cica, rice, collagen)

indian_brands.name: Foxtale (Hula Hoop)
indian_brands.angle: Foxtale pivoting D2C -> house of brands; launched Hula Hoop amid Korean-inspired demand

qcommerce.insight: Conglomerate-owned K-brands (AmorePacific, LG H&H) have mature India supply chains and are deeply stocked on q-commerce; the viral indie/derma brands driving the K-beauty narrative (COSRX, Anua, Some By Mi) are out-of-stock, 'coming soon', or absent. The real Tier 2/3 whitespace is getting indie derma K-beauty onto the q-commerce rail, not the conglomerate brands already there.

regulation.india_import: CDSCO, Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940 + Cosmetics Rules 2020; Form COS-1 application -> COS-2 Registration Certificate via SUGAM portal; manufacturing site registration required; BIS IS 4707 ingredient standards (Part 2 revised Aug 2025); paper filings not accepted as of 2026
